title: EEG neurofeedback 'chair' sessions targeting theta and gamma
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

plain: From about 2008 to 2010, at Baker Victory Services in Western New York, he was put through sessions in what he calls "the chair," brain-wave training that recorded his brain signals and aimed at the slow theta and fast gamma waves. That is what Jordan Jose says, a man who claims he was taken into a UFO program as a child. He speaks of it firsthand and says this is where many of his traumatic memories came back, which, if true, would mean such programs worked on children's minds.
